title: GALA: Geometry-Aware Language Model for Controllable Object Arrangement
title_zh: 【输入内容第一行】的中文翻译：GALA：面向可控物体摆放的几何感知语言模型

paragraphs.en: 总结：GALA是一个具备几何感知能力的语言模型，通过显式点云理解实现可控的3D物体摆放，并开源多源场景数据集。 Reasoning about fine-grained placement constraints, such as support and containment, is essential for realistic 3D scene creation. It remains a significant challenge for existing methods that rely on simplified object representations like oriented bounding box (OBB), which are blind to the detailed geometry. To address this limitation, we introduce GALA, a geometry-aware language model with explicit point cloud perception for controllable object placement. Our model performs autoregressively by predicting the 6D pose of one target object at a time conditioned on the scene context and placement instruction. We utilize a two-stage training strategy: the first stage aligns geometric and textual modalities through pretraining tasks, and the second stage fine-tunes the model for placement. To facilitate this task, we also curate a multi-source scene dataset covering diverse room types and fine-grained furniture arrangements, which will be open-sourced for community benefit. Experiments on our benchmark show our model significantly outperforms baselines without explicit geometric reasoning. We further develop a multi-stage plan-place-verify agent pipeline that uses the model for text-driven scene generation. Project Page: https://xccelephant.github.io/paper/gala/
paragraphs.zh: 总结：GALA是一个具备几何感知能力的语言模型，通过显式点云理解实现可控的3D物体摆放，并开源多源场景数据集。 对支撑、容纳等细粒度摆放约束进行推理，对于逼真的3D场景创建至关重要。 对于依赖有向包围盒（OBB）等简化物体表示的现有方法而言，这仍然是一个重大挑战，因为它们无法感知详细的几何信息。 为了解决这一局限，我们提出了GALA，一个具备显式点云感知能力的几何感知语言模型，用于可控的物体摆放。 我们的模型以自回归方式运行，在场景上下文和摆放指令的条件下，每次预测一个目标物体的6D位姿。 我们采用两阶段训练策略：第一阶段通过预训练任务对齐几何模态与文本模态，第二阶段针对摆放任务对模型进行微调。 为促进该任务的发展，我们还整理了一个涵盖多样房间类型和细粒度家具布局的多源场景数据集，并将开源以惠及社区。 在我们基准测试上的实验表明，我们的模型显著优于缺乏显式几何推理的基线方法。 我们进一步开发了一个多阶段的规划—摆放—验证智能体流水线，利用该模型实现文本驱动的场景生成。 项目主页：https://xccelephant.github.io/paper/gala/

sents.en: 总结：GALA是一个具备几何感知能力的语言模型，通过显式点云理解实现可控的3D物体摆放，并开源多源场景数据集。 Reasoning about fine-grained placement constraints, such as support and containment, is essential for realistic 3D scene creation.
sents.zh: 总结：GALA是一个具备几何感知能力的语言模型，通过显式点云理解实现可控的3D物体摆放，并开源多源场景数据集。 对支撑、容纳等细粒度摆放约束进行推理，对于逼真的3D场景创建至关重要。

sents.en: It remains a significant challenge for existing methods that rely on simplified object representations like oriented bounding box (OBB), which are blind to the detailed geometry.
sents.zh: 对于依赖有向包围盒（OBB）等简化物体表示的现有方法而言，这仍然是一个重大挑战，因为它们无法感知详细的几何信息。

sents.en: To address this limitation, we introduce GALA, a geometry-aware language model with explicit point cloud perception for controllable object placement.
sents.zh: 为了解决这一局限，我们提出了GALA，一个具备显式点云感知能力的几何感知语言模型，用于可控的物体摆放。

sents.en: Our model performs autoregressively by predicting the 6D pose of one target object at a time conditioned on the scene context and placement instruction.
sents.zh: 我们的模型以自回归方式运行，在场景上下文和摆放指令的条件下，每次预测一个目标物体的6D位姿。

sents.en: We utilize a two-stage training strategy: the first stage aligns geometric and textual modalities through pretraining tasks, and the second stage fine-tunes the model for placement.
sents.zh: 我们采用两阶段训练策略：第一阶段通过预训练任务对齐几何模态与文本模态，第二阶段针对摆放任务对模型进行微调。

sents.en: To facilitate this task, we also curate a multi-source scene dataset covering diverse room types and fine-grained furniture arrangements, which will be open-sourced for community benefit.
sents.zh: 为促进该任务的发展，我们还整理了一个涵盖多样房间类型和细粒度家具布局的多源场景数据集，并将开源以惠及社区。

sents.en: Experiments on our benchmark show our model significantly outperforms baselines without explicit geometric reasoning.
sents.zh: 在我们基准测试上的实验表明，我们的模型显著优于缺乏显式几何推理的基线方法。

sents.en: We further develop a multi-stage plan-place-verify agent pipeline that uses the model for text-driven scene generation.
sents.zh: 我们进一步开发了一个多阶段的规划—摆放—验证智能体流水线，利用该模型实现文本驱动的场景生成。
